title: 2026 Pokémon - DOUBLADE - IR Illustration Rare - Perfect Order - 098/088
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a rare, English language Pokémon card featuring the character Doublade from the Perfect Order set. Produced by The Pokémon Company in 2026, this Stage 2 Pokémon card has 100 HP and a holo finish. Illustrated by Anesaki Dynamic, the card is a valuable addition to any collector's deck, particularly for fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. This standard-sized card is designed for ages 6 and up and is a sought-after item for collectors of rare and unique Pokémon cards.
